users.title: User Management
users.tips: Only administrators can manage accounts and grant workflows. Members can only see the workflows (and their certificates) explicitly granted to them.

providers.title: OAuth2 Providers
providers.tips: Configure one or more OAuth2 identity providers to enable the corresponding Sign-in buttons on the login page. Both the authoritative endpoints and field mapping fall back to built-in presets when left blank.

username.title: Username
username.tips: Email you can use to sign in to your account.

password.tips: It's recommended to change your password regularly, or sooner if you suspect any issues.

ca.title: System-wide CA
ca.tips: You can use different CAs for each workflow as well. If you want to do this, please visit the credentials page.

provider.label: ACME CA provider
provider.help: Notes: The certificate validity lifetime, certificate algorithm, domain names count, and support for wildcard domain names are allowed may vary among different providers. After switching service providers, please check whether the configuration of the workflows needs to be adjusted.

timeout.label: Certificate obtaining timeout
timeout.tooltip: If you don't understand this option, just keep it by default.

certificates_warning_days_before_expire.label: Certificate expiration warning threshold
certificates_warning_days_before_expire.placeholder: Please enter the certificate expiration warning threshold
certificates_warning_days_before_expire.help: Notes: It determines when the certificate will be marked as "Expiring-Soon".

workflow_runs_retention_max_days.label: Workflow runs retention max days
workflow_runs_retention_max_days.placeholder: Please enter the maximum number of retention days for workflow history runs
workflow_runs_retention_max_days.help: Notes: Set to 0 to disable cleanup workflow history runs. Recommend setting to 180 days or more.

certificates_retention_max_days.label: Expired certificates retention max days
certificates_retention_max_days.placeholder: Please enter the maximum number of retention days for expired certificates
certificates_retention_max_days.help: Notes: Set to <b>0</emb> to disable cleanup expired certificates.
